# Madeirabook

> Madeirabook is not a hotel catalogue. It is an editorial portal of rare
> Atlantic places — curated escapes to Madeira for guests who seek honest
> natural luxury, silence, and a clean ocean instead of mass tourism.
> Two-minute emotional gateways lead to three bookable stays.

## Pages

- https://madeirabook-platform.vercel.app/ — Portal home
- https://madeirabook-platform.vercel.app/booking — Choose your escape: three
  stays (Apartamentos do Mar 303, Apartamentos do Mar 607, Penthouse on the
  Beach Madeira). Reservations handled at app.madeirabook.com
- https://madeirabook-platform.vercel.app/gateways — Gallery of emotional
  gateways grouped by element (ocean, terra, forest, sun, wild)
- https://madeirabook-platform.vercel.app/gateway/dolphins — Gateway: dolphins
- https://madeirabook-platform.vercel.app/gateway/above-clouds — Gateway:
  above the clouds
- https://madeirabook-platform.vercel.app/gateway/levada-drone — Gateway:
  levada drone
- https://madeirabook-platform.vercel.app/sluice-test — Two-minute escape
  prototype (intro, video, breath, immersion)

## Sister site

- https://www.madeirabook.com — Original landing and booking content
